back: Checking each item in turn from the first until the target is found or the end is reached.
Best case: first item (1 comparison). Worst case: last item or missing (n comparisons). Works on unsorted data.
Repeated passes comparing neighbouring items and swapping them if out of order.
Temp ← A; A ← B; B ← Temp. Without Temp one value is lost.
A Swapped flag stops the sort after a pass with no swaps; each pass can stop one place earlier.
Data already in order: one pass, n − 1 comparisons, no swaps.
Reverse order: n(n − 1)/2 comparisons and swaps (28 for 8 items).
The largest unsorted item has reached the end of the unsorted part.
After the search loop, test the found flag; output a message if the item was never found.
